answer: Three things mark the true chest. First, Proof of joiner chest via dovetail count: a chest the joiner closes only after 10 dovetails are cut true, each dovetail tried dry first. Second, the horizon, the shelter a closed lid gives its contents. Third, the dune, the small sweet click of a dovetail seating home. The lantern is what stays outside, damp, dust, thieves, because every joint was tried dry first. A forger needs 10 dovetails cut to the hair, a saw, a chisel and a steady hand, and the lid still gaps.
